articles.title: modular/modular
articles.excerpt: The Modular Platform (includes MAX & Mojo)
articles.summary: Modular 平台，旗下包含 MAX 编译器和 Mojo 编程语言。Mojo 融合 Python 易用性与 C 级性能，面向 AI 基础设施和高性能计算场景。开发者可用它编写可编译为高效机器码的 Python 风格代码，解决 AI 模型部署和算子优化的性能瓶颈问题。

articles.title: mattpocock/skills
articles.excerpt: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
articles.summary: 面向真实工程师的 Agent Skills 合集。作者直接分享自己 .agents 目录中的技能定义，可供 AI 编程助手（如 Claude Code）调用。这些技能封装了实用的工程经验，帮助开发者提升代码质量、遵循最佳实践，适用于日常编码和项目维护。

articles.title: AprilNEA/OpenLogi
articles.excerpt: ⚡️A native, local-first alternative to Logitech Options+, written in Rust 🦀 — remap buttons, DPI, and SmartShift over HID++. No account, no telemetry.
articles.summary: 用 Rust 编写的原生本地优先替代品，用于取代 Logitech Options+。通过 HID++ 协议重映射鼠标按键、调整 DPI 和 SmartShift，无需账号、无遥测。适合注重隐私的罗技外设用户，在 Linux/macOS/Windows 上提供本地化的设备配置能力。

articles.title: obra/superpowers
articles.excerpt: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
articles.summary: 一套智能体技能框架和软件开发方法论，强调实用有效。为 AI 编码智能体提供结构化技能、工作流和规范，使其在真实项目中更可控、可复用。典型场景是团队将工程实践沉淀为 agent skills，提升 AI 辅助开发的稳定性和一致性。

articles.title: cursor/plugins
articles.excerpt: Cursor plugin specification and official plugins
articles.summary: Cursor 编辑器的插件规范与官方插件仓库。定义了插件的编写标准、API 和发布方式，让开发者能为 Cursor 扩展功能。适用于希望定制 AI 编程环境、构建自定义工具链的开发者，是 Cursor 生态的基础设施。

articles.title: santifer/career-ops
articles.excerpt: Open-source AI job search: scan job portals, evaluate listings with a structured A-F rubric into a 1.0-5.0 score, tailor your CV, track applications — runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity…)
articles.summary: 开源 AI 求职助手。可扫描招聘门户，用 A-F 评分规则将职位清单量化为 1.0-5.0 分，裁剪定制简历并跟踪申请进度。全部本地运行在 AI 编码 CLI（如 Claude Code）中，保护隐私，适合求职者高效筛选和投递职位。

articles.title: akitaonrails/ai-memory
articles.excerpt: Solution for long term memory for agent coding CLIs and to facilitate handoff between different agent vendors
articles.summary: 为 AI 编码 CLI 提供长期记忆的解决方案，并支持不同 agent 供应商之间的交接。它将上下文持久化存储，在会话间保留项目决策和用户偏好，避免每次重新解释。适合多工具协作的团队，实现智能体记忆共享与无缝切换。

articles.title: harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo
articles.excerpt: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
articles.summary: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。集成文案生成、配音、字幕、素材匹配和剪辑，无需手动操作。适合自媒体营销快速批量产出内容，也可用于个人创作者快速制作视频。

articles.title: agent-substrate/substrate
articles.excerpt: Agent Substrate: the core system
articles.summary: Agent Substrate 核心系统，为智能体提供底层运行环境和基础组件。它定义了 agent 之间交互、任务调度和状态管理的通用机制，是构建复杂多智能体应用的基石。开发者可用它搭建稳健、可扩展的自主 agent 系统。

articles.title: chaitanyagiri/munder-difflin
articles.excerpt: local multi-agent harness
articles.summary: 本地多智能体运行框架（local multi-agent harness）。它允许多个 AI agent 在本地环境中协同工作，处理复杂的子任务分工和结果汇总。适合隐私敏感的场景，无需云端服务即可编排本地智能体群组完成自动化任务。

articles.title: PostHog/posthog
articles.excerpt: 🦔 PostHog is the leading platform for building self-driving products. Our developer tools – AI observability, analytics, session replay, flags, experiments, error tracking, logs, and more – capture all the context agents need to diagnose problems, uncover opportunities, and ship fixes. Steer it all
articles.summary: 用于构建自动驾驶产品的一站式开源平台，涵盖 AI 可观测性、分析、会话回放、特性开关、实验、错误追踪和日志等开发者工具。产品团队可据此快速洞察用户行为、验证功能并定位问题，是自托管产品分析的领先选择。

articles.title: mahlernim/google-timeline-visualizer
articles.excerpt: Visualize your year in travel using your Google Location History (Timeline) data
articles.summary: 利用 Google 位置历史（Timeline）数据可视化你一年的旅行足迹。导入导出的 JSON 数据，生成地图和时间线视图，展示去过的地方和路线。适合个人用户回顾年度旅行，也用于隐私数据自我分析和可视化探索。

articles.title: volcengine/OpenViking
articles.excerpt: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
articles.summary: 面向 AI Agent 的自进化上下文数据库，统一 Agent 记忆、知识 RAG 和技能。它让智能体在运行时动态积累和整理知识，自动优化检索结果。适合构建具备长期学习和个性化能力的 Agent，减少外部知识库的碎片化问题。

articles.title: JuliusBrussee/caveman
articles.excerpt: 🪨 why use many token when few token do trick — Claude Code skill that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like caveman
articles.summary: 一个 Claude Code 技能，通过模仿原始人语言风格减少约 65% 的 token 消耗。它压缩自然语言指令，保留核心语义，降低 AI 调用的成本。适合高频使用代码助手、对 token 开销敏感的个人开发者或团队。

articles.title: makeplane/plane
articles.excerpt: 🔥🔥🔥 Open-source Jira, Linear, Monday, and ClickUp alternative. Plane is a modern project management platform to manage tasks, sprints, docs, and triage.
articles.summary: 开源项目管理和问题追踪平台，可替代 Jira、Linear、Monday 和 ClickUp。支持任务、冲刺（sprint）、文档和工单分诊等功能，界面现代简洁。适合希望自托管、掌控数据的中小团队，提供敏捷开发的一站式解决方案。

articles.title: Tencent/AI-Infra-Guard

articles.title: RyanCodrai/turbovec

articles.title: How Cloudflare detects MCP traffic and helps secure it

articles.title: Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare's Certificate Transparency Monitoring is now generally available. The biggest change: we no longer email you about certificates Cloudflare issued for your domain, so when an alert lands in your inbox, it's worth a look.

articles.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report H1 2026: 1 Tbps attacks soar as DNS floods and geopolitical tensions drive a new wave
articles.excerpt: In the first half of 2026, Cloudflare detected a 519% surge in hyper-volumetric DDos attacks across its network. These attacks were driven heavily by DNS and CLDAP reflection vectors. This report breaks down how major geopolitical conflicts reshaped the global cyber threat landscape.

articles.title: Everything we launched during Agents Week

articles.title: Unveiling good and bad behaviors on the Agentic Internet
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is shifting bot mitigation from point-in-time Risk assessment to continuous Trust evaluation. articles.title: Introducing Radar Researcher: An AI tool for exploring Internet data in plain language
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare Radar Researcher is a new AI-powered tool that lets you explore global Internet trends and traffic data using plain language. Built entirely on Cloudflare's Developer Platform, it turns natural language queries into real, interactive charts.

articles.title: Announcing Cloudflare Ambassadors, Community Engineers, and another $1M in open-source funding
articles.excerpt: We are launching updated community programs, including Cloudflare Ambassadors and Community Engineers, backed by $1M in open-source funding. Learn how we are supporting maintainers and scaling our developer community.

articles.title: Unifying Workers AI and AI Gateway into a single AI control plane
articles.excerpt: Cloudflare is unifying AI Gateway and Workers AI into a single control plane, giving developers observability, billing, and dynamic routing across both managed GPUs and external providers. Learn how unified bindings and model-first routing simplify building resilient AI applications.

articles.title: Cloudflare AI Search: give your agents a search engine for your data
articles.excerpt: AI Search makes search easier than ever, with no Cloudflare primitives to stitch together. Point it at your data to create a search for your own files and websites. We're also sharing a preview of our new pricing model.

articles.title: The next generation of MCP
articles.excerpt: The next version of MCP has a rewritten, stateless core that just works on Workers. We cover upgrades to the protocol, the new feature lifecycle and SDK migration path, and hear from early adopters already running it in production.

articles.title: From ranking to recommended: get your site ready to thrive in the age of AI agents
articles.excerpt: More than half of requests now come from machines, not people. Agent Readiness shows how well agents can discover and read your site, while Answer Engine Optimization tracks how often AI assistants recommend you.

articles.title: Building an open Agentic Internet: readable, discoverable, callable, and payable
articles.excerpt: Agents are a new kind of visitor. They don't render CSS or click ads, but they have a paying human on the other end. Block them and you block your customer. We're building the open tools and protocols so publishers and agents can cooperate and not collide.

articles.title: Introducing Kitesurf: The agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates on Cloudflare Workers
articles.excerpt: We should be giving all agents tools that excel at what’s important for an AI model. Kitesurf is Cloudflare’s new stateless, highly scalable, and cost-effective web browser that runs entirely on top of Workers and was designed specifically for the Agentic Cloud.

articles.title: Give any website a WebMCP interface
articles.excerpt: Today we're launching a developer preview of WebMCP on Cloudflare. With one switch, any site becomes usable by browser AI agents — no new APIs, no origin changes — while the human stays in control and creators keep their traffic.
